characters.name: den døve Manden
characters.description: A middle-aged man with a tall, sturdy build. He has short gray hair and a rugged, lined face. Often seen in simple, practical clothing suitable for farm work, usually a tunic and trousers. He appears oblivious to the surrounding comedy due to his deafness. Likely to be found carrying tools or equipment related to farming, such as an axe when working.

characters.name: Kjærringen
characters.description: A middle-aged woman with a slightly plump figure. She has dark hair usually tied in a bun, and expressive eyes that show her emotions vividly. Wears a simple dress typical of rural women, along with an apron. Her demeanor changes quickly from being sweet to frustrated, especially when the servant boy is involved.

characters.name: Gutten
characters.description: A young boy with a lean frame, probably in his early teens. He has short curly hair and a mischievous expression. Dressed in simple work clothes like a loose shirt and shorts, typically used by farmhands. Often carries a playful or cunning aura, particularly when he is orchestrating plans between the characters.

characters.name: Paal Andrestuen
characters.description: A man slightly younger than den døve Manden, with a slimmer build and curly, brown hair. He has a gentle face but often looks anxious due to the situation he's entangled in. Dressed modestly like the other villagers, preferring earth-toned clothes. Tends to skulk around when meeting Kjærringen, aware of the potential risks.
